headline: Committee to review $70,000 EMS funding, $43,500 police grant, an ALPR pilot program, and a 20-year solar energy agreement with 978 Solar Development LLC.
summary: The committee will take up new spending authorizations for the Fire and Police Departments, a pilot license plate recognition program, and a long-term solar energy billing agreement. It will also revisit a long list of previously tabled items dating back to 2015.
items: Authorize spending $300 gift from the Estate of Constance M. Cataldi for the Fire Dept.
Authorize spending $70,000 from Cataldo Ambulance Services for Fire Dept. EMS Coordinator salary.
Authorize spending $43,500 BJA FY25 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance (JAG) Grant for Police Dept.
Introduce pilot program for Sound Thinking Plate Ranger Automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR).
Consider 20-year NET metering electricity offtake and billing credit agreements with 978 Solar Development LLC (New Leaf Energy).
Transfer $2,000 from Legal Services to Claims.
Review tabled item: Home Rule Petition for Credible Service for Six Lawrence Fire Fighters (383/26).
Review tabled item: Request investigation of unclaimed properties listed as City of Lawrence on MissingMoney.com (187/26).
Review tabled item: Accept donation of 15-passenger van from Merrimack Valley Transit Authority (160/26).
Review tabled item: Review of Lawrence Redevelopment Authority's financials (117/25).
Review tabled item: Opioid Settlement Funds update - Modelo Application Development (44/25).
Review tabled item: Transfer $400,000 from ARPA/Free Cash to Small Business through Prospering Lawrence Grant (568/24).
Review tabled item: Resolution on reimbursement requirement for Creating a Thriving Lawrence Grant awardees (76B/24).
Review tabled item: Amend City's Housing Development Incentive Plan (HDIP) tax increment exemption percentage (59/24).
Review tabled item: AARPA Funding for Education (173/22).
Review tabled item: Tax collection and local receipts update for fiscal year 2024 (234/21).
Review tabled item: Real estate non-utilization tax on vacant and abandoned property citywide (201/20).
Review tabled item: Review of state funds received for fiscal operation (397/19).
Review tabled item: Appropriation transfer year-end transfers between departmental accounts (193/19A).
Review tabled item: Pavement cost recovery agreements review (342/18).
Review tabled item: Properties with outstanding taxes due to City of Lawrence (197/15).
